info.title: STDU R1-007 Supplier Staff API
info.description: Proposed staff-only manual Supplier and SupplierOffer API. No supplier crawling, public supplier surface, public purchase price, automatic product link, purchase order or stock workflow.

servers.description: Same-origin reverse proxy; no production domain is assumed.

tags.name: supplier-staff
tags.description: Session-authenticated staff supplier, offer and exact-match workflow.

x-staff-response-headers.X-Request-Id: server-generated UUID in response and error envelope

x-permission-catalog-extension.integration: Additive runtime/composed RBAC catalog only; do not edit frozen R1-002/R1-004/R1-006A artifacts, protected-admin permission set, role templates or grants.

x-global-invariants: All paths in this document are staff-only; there are no public supplier paths.
Every mutation requires an Idempotency-Key string of 8-128 characters and uses the frozen R1-002 staff cookie, exact configured Origin and staff-bound CSRF token.
All offer and match responses require supplier permissions; match views additionally require catalog.products.read and catalog.references.read.

Catalog identity is the exact frozen R1-004 tuple (brandId, manufacturerName, originalPartNumber, modification) with its NFC/outer-U+0020-only normalization; no fuzzy candidate, analog, or auto-link exists.
Money is a canonical decimal string, never a JSON number. Currency is explicit; no FX conversion, assumed VAT or default currency.
All responses containing contact, purchase cost, internal notes, source or matching data are no-store and never enter PublicCatalogProduct or PublicQuotation DTOs.
No route creates a CatalogProduct, updates public price, changes a quotation, sends a supplier request, fetches a source URL or performs a bulk decision.

Idempotency scope is authenticated actorStaffUserId plus fixed R1-007 scope plus key across every mutation; RFC 8785 canonical request envelope is SHA-256 hashed and completed status/body is durably stored in SupplierCommandIdempotency in the same PostgreSQL transaction as a successful mutation and its AuditEvent.

PostgreSQL transaction-scoped actor/scope/key serialization makes same-key concurrent requests replay one saved result; identical retries survive API restart, hash mismatch is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED, and deterministic VERSION_CONFLICT is replayed until a corrected request uses a new key.
Idempotency results are re-authorized before replay, contain only sanitized mutation receipts/proposal responses, and are retained indefinitely; no cleanup runs in R1.

ProductMatchProposal has at most one PENDING record per offer/revision/product tuple; terminal REJECTED/APPROVED history permits a new proposal ID, while SupplierOffer has one current-match pointer and unlink never automatically restores an older proposal.

ACTIVE supplier tax identity is unique by canonical jurisdiction/identifier; archived history does not reserve that identity and re-registration creates a distinct Supplier ID without merging history.

get.summary: List suppliers visible to the staff user
x-invariants: Keyset pagination; archived rows are returned only when explicitly requested.
Supplier is not SellerLegalEntity; no default legal or contact data is generated.
The first complete SupplierRevision, current profile projection and audit commit atomically; receipt returns revisionId only.

Tax identifier and jurisdiction must be both null or both present. RU identifiers are checksum-valid 10/12 ASCII digits stored as strings with leading zeroes; foreign identifiers use NFC and outer U+0020 trim only.
Uniqueness applies to canonical tax identity among ACTIVE suppliers only. A pair found only on archived rows creates a new Supplier ID and history; no unarchive or merge occurs.
Private contact, tax identifier and internal notes require staff RBAC.
expectedVersion compare-and-swap; accepted profile change appends a complete immutable SupplierRevision and atomically updates projection, pointer and audit; receipt returns revisionId only.
State changes use archive endpoint.
Profile snapshots contain historical contacts/requisites/notes and are staff-only; no such values are copied to global AuditEvent.

post.summary: Archive supplier without deleting offer history
x-invariants: One-way state change; does not cascade; archive removes offers from current comparison but preserves history.
Responses show stale/unknown freshness and current match validity separately.
Cross-currency rows are grouped and never FX-converted; no best-supplier recommendation or selection.

For sortBy=purchaseCost, currency groups sort by ISO code with COLLATE C ascending (null currency last); sortDirection changes exact numeric order only within each group (null cost last); ties sort supplier legalName COLLATE C ascending then offerId ascending.

Price-sort cursor is keyset-based and bound to filters/sort/direction; it carries currency null-rank, currency, cost null-rank, exact canonical decimal string, supplierName, and offerId. Decimal values are never converted to float. Default ordering is observedAt DESC, offerId ASC.

post.summary: Create one manual supplier offer without an automatic catalog link
x-invariants: Active supplier required; first immutable revision is created in the same transaction; currentMatchProposalId starts null. Mutation response contains only id, version and revisionId.

get.summary: Read offer, current revision, and effective match
x-invariants: Effective match is CURRENT only while current identities equal the approved snapshots; otherwise REVIEW_REQUIRED.

expectedVersion compare-and-swap; full new snapshot appended; historical revision is never overwritten; price change has no CatalogProduct/Quotation side effect. Mutation response contains only id, version and revisionId.

post.summary: Archive one offer while preserving its history
x-invariants: One-way root transition; does not delete revisions or match decisions. Mutation response contains only id and version.
All revisions are private and ordered newest first; no revision is deleted by stale/expiry/archive.

get.summary: Find exact identity candidates without linking them
x-invariants: Returns only complete exact frozen R1-004 identity tuples; incomplete identity returns no candidates and a reason code; text similarity is never used.

get.summary: List one-by-one match proposals for staff review
x-invariants: No bulk-decision route; each row preserves its own offer and catalog identity snapshots.

post.summary: Create a pending proposal for one exact candidate
x-invariants: The target product must be in the exact candidate response; proposal remains PENDING; current offer link is unchanged.
A partial unique index permits at most one PENDING proposal for (offerId, offerRevisionId, proposedProductId); REJECTED/APPROVED history does not block a new proposal ID after rejection or unlink.
Every new proposal has its own audit event. Same Idempotency-Key replays its persisted response; a new key is required for a new attempt. No automatic match or pointer restoration occurs.

post.summary: Approve or reject one pending proposal
x-invariants: Locks offer, proposal and product; revalidates expected versions, exact current identity and expected current pointer; writes one terminal decision, pointer and success audit atomically. A terminal proposal cannot be changed. Approval may replace only the exact expected current pointer.

post.summary: Clear one current match with an audited reason
x-invariants: Expected current proposal and offer version must match; proposal history is unchanged; unlink is never implicit.

get.summary: Read sanitized audit history for one supplier
x-invariants: Audit DTO contains IDs, actor, time, action, bounded reason codes and changed-field names only; no contacts, notes, offer cost or raw provenance.

get.summary: Read sanitized audit history for one offer
x-invariants: Audit DTO never returns raw cost, source URL, contact, note or request body; revision details use the separate offer-read route.

staffCookie.name: __Host-stdu_staff
staffCookie.description: Exact frozen R1-002 opaque HttpOnly staff cookie; clients use credentials:include and never construct a token.

OriginHeader.name: Origin
OriginHeader.description: Must exactly match the configured trusted origin.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required on every mutation. Exact key string is scoped by authenticated actor and fixed R1-007 scope; durable same-hash retries replay the stored response, while a different payload returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.

schema.description: purchaseCost sorts numeric amounts only within deterministic currency groups; see listSupplierOffers invariants.

taxIdentifier.description: RU INN digits; server also validates applicable checksum and preserves leading zeroes.

PurchaseCost.description: Positive canonical base-10 decimal string, no exponent or trailing zero; never a JSON number.

revisionId.description: Present for create or profile edit; omitted for archive. No private profile values are returned.

Conflict.description: OCC, identity, state, uniqueness or idempotency-key conflict; no partial domain mutation. A deterministic terminal OCC/domain 409 may persist its idempotency response in the same transaction without a success AuditEvent; hash-mismatch key reuse creates no new record.

Unprocessable.description: Semantically incomplete or invalid source facts; no mutation.

SupplierMutation.description: Mutation receipt only; read-protected supplier details require suppliers.read.

OfferMutation.description: Mutation receipt only; purchase cost and supplier detail are not returned by write-only permission.

CandidateList.description: Exact candidates only; never an automatic link.

Proposal.description: Proposal after a single create/decision command.

x-idempotency-contract.table: SupplierCommandIdempotency (sixth R1-007 table; not the import-scoped R1-006 records)
x-idempotency-contract.keyScope: (actorStaffUserId, fixed scope R1-007, exact Idempotency-Key string of 8-128 characters)
x-idempotency-contract.requestHash: SHA-256(RFC 8785 canonical JSON of API version, operationId, HTTP method, normalized path/query, authenticated actor ID and validated canonical request DTO including expected versions; excludes key)
x-idempotency-contract.transaction: PostgreSQL transaction-scoped advisory lock derived from exact scope tuple; successful domain change, AuditEvent and saved response commit together; deterministic terminal OCC/domain 409 stores a response without domain mutation or success AuditEvent
x-idempotency-contract.concurrent: Same hash waits and replays; a different request hash for the existing tuple returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; the unique constraint is the durable backstop
x-idempotency-contract.restart: Completed responses replay from PostgreSQL after restart, after auth, CSRF/Origin, schema and current permissions are rechecked
x-idempotency-contract.versionConflict: Exact retry replays saved VERSION_CONFLICT; corrected expected version or payload requires a new key
x-idempotency-contract.response: Persist exact status and sanitized response DTO only; no request body, contacts, notes, source URLs or purchase costs
x-idempotency-contract.retention: Append-only, retained indefinitely in R1; no purge job

x-tax-identity-validation.pair: taxIdentifier and taxJurisdiction are both absent/null or both present; when present jurisdiction is an uppercase valid ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 code
x-tax-identity-validation.RU: For taxJurisdiction=RU require exactly 10 or 12 ASCII digits as a string, preserve leading zeroes, and validate check digits using weights [2,4,10,3,5,9,4,6,8] for 10 digits; [7,2,4,10,3,5,9,4,6,8] over the first 10 digits for the 12-digit first check; [3,7,2,4,10,3,5,9,4,6,8] over the first 11 digits for the second; check digit=(weighted sum mod 11) mod 10
x-tax-identity-validation.nonRU: Unicode NFC and trim outer ASCII U+0020 only; preserve case, internal characters and leading zeroes; no RU digit/length/checksum rule
x-tax-identity-validation.uniqueness: Canonical (taxJurisdiction,taxIdentifier) is unique only among ACTIVE suppliers; archived history does not block a new Supplier ID and is never merged
